description: Dynamic-array filter / dedupe / sort family — FILTER, UNIQUE, SORT, SORTBY (Excel 365). 24 perspectives (6 per function); spill outputs flow through the same skip-oracle path as MUNIT and TEXTSPLIT (oracle compare_value cannot navigate ArrayValue). Live cases cover scalar fallback and error returns — FILTER if_empty scalar, FILTER no-match #CALC!, FILTER mask shape #VALUE!, FILTER include error propagation, UNIQUE exactly_once-empty #CALC!, SORT sort_index out-of-range #VALUE!, SORT invalid sort_order #VALUE!, SORTBY shape mismatch #VALUE!, SORTBY invalid order #VALUE!.

cases.skipped: FILTER row-axis result is a 2D spill (2x1 array); oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in filter_eval_test.cpp cover the column-vector mask path.
FILTER col-axis result is a 1x2 spill; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in filter_eval_test.cpp cover the row-vector mask path.
UNIQUE row-axis result is a 3x1 spill; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in unique_eval_test.cpp cover row-axis dedup ordering.
UNIQUE by_col=TRUE result is a 1x3 spill; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in unique_eval_test.cpp cover col-axis dedup.
UNIQUE exactly_once=TRUE result is a 2x1 spill of the rows that occur once; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in unique_eval_test.cpp cover this path.
UNIQUE case-insensitive ASCII text dedup yields a 2x1 spill; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in unique_eval_test.cpp cover the case-insensitive equality semantics.
UNIQUE pass-through (all rows distinct) returns a 3x1 spill; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in unique_eval_test.cpp cover identity preservation.
SORT default row-axis ascending yields a 3x1 spill; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in sort_eval_test.cpp cover the default ordering.
SORT by_col=TRUE yields a 1x3 spill; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in sort_eval_test.cpp cover the column-axis path.
SORT sort_order=-1 yields a 3x1 descending spill; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in sort_eval_test.cpp cover descending sort.
SORT mixed-kind ordering (Number < Text < Bool < Error < Blank) yields a 4x1 spill; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in sort_eval_test.cpp cover the canonical kind-rank.
SORTBY single-key ascending result is a 3x1 spill; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in sortby_eval_test.cpp cover the single-key path.
SORTBY single-key descending result is a 3x1 spill; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in sortby_eval_test.cpp cover order=-1.
SORTBY two-key composite sort result is a 4x1 spill; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in sortby_eval_test.cpp cover multi-key composition.
SORTBY row-vector key sorts cols, yielding a 1x3 spill; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit tests in sortby_eval_test.cpp cover axis inference.
